Not your typical Vietnamese restaurant. A wonderful experience
Apr 2025 • Friends
Clean, attentive staff & good food. This place is around the corner from our hotel Hilton Garden Inn. Super easy to walk to with English menu. The food is something we have eaten at the home of my Vietnamese friend back in the states. It was a wonderful experience to have in Hanoi. A nice variety from the soup noodles and rice dishes. The staff was attentive especially the woman there (sorry lost the sheet of paper with her name that we wrote down) who helped us select the dishes and gave us an extra lettuce basket. Also watched her really cleaned up the tables/ chairs & set up the tables.
Just wish there was AC but most places in Hanoi do not have AC.

Very good food; pleasant staff
Dec 2019 • Couples
Definitely I’ll be back for the very good, the inexpensive menu, the clean restaurant & the nice, accomodating waitresses & génial host!

We have been here at VI QUANG 2 twice already. Recommend the heart of coconut salad, the grilled pork on lemongrass stalks, the stuffed thinly-sliced pork leg and the grilled beef dish.

Special thanks to Hwe and Nem (?) for showing us how to wrap these dishes in rice paper & to Nem for the healthy yogurt she made herself! 💥💥💥💥💥

MARTIN ST AMAND & MARIA DUNCAN

Great local restaurant
Oct 2018
Just off the Opera House Square and five minutes from our hotel we found this place by accident - and were really happy to have done so. We were the only non locals eating there and were found a good table quickly. Our waitress took our order but paused to check how hot we would like the green chilli sauce, and when the lemongrass pork wraps arrived checked we knew how to assemble them in the rice paper. Great friendly service and for this part of Hanoi excellent value too.
